A.claim: If a Beal counterexample exists, one exists with all three exponents in {4} union {odd primes}; equivalently the signature-by-signature strategy is legitimate.

B.claim: Beal Prize status (verified 2026-09-17): US $1,000,000 held by the AMS, donated by D. Andrew Beal, announced in the Notices of the AMS December 1997; awarded for EITHER a proof OR a counterexample, conditional on publication in a refereed and respected mathematics publication, a two-year waiting period, and verification by two outside experts chose
